notes.title: Weekly update - Week 2
notes.content:
Hey all,

Happy new year! Hopefully this is the year you all get to try out our game out! With luck, we might have a demo by the end of February. Our take on a new version of dark cloud meets Hogwarts Legacy with multiplayer with building and crafting features.

We doubled the size of the first dungeon and the content you can do in it now. As well as added new puzzle systems and spawning mechanics for monsters. 

We also added consumables to the game.

We are currently working on the wand crafting system and leveling of wands.
